items.title: Teams with the Most Pressure Ahead of the 2026-27 NBA Season | Third Apron Podcast
items.body_excerpt: The start of the 2026-27 NBA regular season is one week away. Sam and I preview it by going over the teams we believe have the highest stakes. We also discuss the Brandin Podziemski and Peyton Pritchard extensions. You can follow Yossi on: Twitter:…
